item.title: Some 300 cab drivers stopped from working after regulation breaches, minister says
item.description: 297 Y-plate drivers and 20 operators were banned from working in the past month

item.title: Youth charged with attempted murder tried to run victim over three times
item.description: Victim recounts how 20-year-old Denzil Farrugia and several others he had called to the scene of the incident, surrounded him and assaulted him, before trying to damage his • Accused allegedly got a motorcycle helmet, jumped onto victim’s car and started damaging it

item.title: Female representation in local councils at 28.2%, study finds
item.description: Government-commissioned study on women’s participation in local councils finds female participation and candidacy have increased steadily since the establishment of local councils, with the number of women members doubling between 1993 and 2024

item.title: Defence in hospitals case: ‘State would be better off abandoning reliance on Harbinson’s report’
item.description: Court hears submissions on formal request filed by defence to formally declare harbinson unwilling or unable to testify

item.title: Man stabbed in Żurrieq argument
item.description: 68-year-old man suffers grievous injuries during argument with a neighbour in Żurrieq on Friday afternoon

item.title: 36% of managers are women
item.description: Malta records second-largest increase in women in management in the European Union. Nearly 36% of Maltese managers are women up from 26% ten years ago

item.title: Paola parish appeals against cafeteria refusal
item.description: Poala parish priest Marc André Camilleri has filed an appeal before the Environment and Planning Review Tribunal challenging the refusal of a proposal by the Paola parish to include a cafeteria within the Christ the King Basilica complex

item.title: Europe’s competitiveness must be built on investment and quality jobs, not deregulation
item.description: Europe’s competitiveness will not be secured by weakening rights. It will be secured by strengthening the real economy and ensuring that growth translates into stability, resilience and shared prosperity

item.title: 187 Maltese evacuated from UAE land in Malta
item.description: Evacuation flight from the UAE coordinated by the Maltese Foreign Ministry brings home 187 Maltese nationals

item.title: Court protects spouse due to serious domestic violence
item.description: A judgment delivered on 23 February 2026 by the Civil Court (Family Section) in a case presided by Judge Jacqueline Padovani Grima, confirmed that domestic violence is a ground for separation under civil law
